Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for sending the completed form; looks good. We can absolutely provide a provisional PO number for your finance team to reference while the SOW and final billing terms are completed. Two quick process notes so everyone's aligned: 

1) Provisional PO issuance: Procurement issues a provisional PO with a temporary spend cap. We mark it as "pilot-only" in our ledger and update once the SOW is signed.

2) Spend guard recommendation: For pilots we typically set a conservative temporary cap (we use the spend-cap matrix below as a guide). For your size and expected token/usage profile, I'm proposing a $25,000 / month cap initially, with an automated alert at 80% and a hard block at 100% until procurement reviews.

3) Line items: To avoid mismatch later, please confirm the canonical line-item names you expect on invoices (e.g., "Inference Units - realtime", "Storage - KV cache") so we can mirror them on the PO.

I've attached our spend guidance matrix for quick reference. Ben, can you take the procurement lead on issuing the provisional PO and coordinate the ledger tag? Karthik — once we have the PO number, can you apply the spend guard in billing?

Attachment: redwood-spendcap-matrix.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt

From: Michael Chen <mchen@vendsys.io>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: PO issued (PO-34219) — line item clarification needed

Hi Hannah / Alyssa —

BlueHarbor's AP team just uploaded the PO to our portal; the reference is PO-34219. I've attached the PDF they sent for your visibility. Two issues we noticed that will block our billing automation:

1) Line item naming: The PO lists a single line "Cloud credits" (qty 1) with a total dollar amount. Our invoice engine expects granular line items: "Inference Units - realtime (per 1k tokens)" and "Support - standard" so we can map usage against the PO.

2) Spend cap not explicit: The PO amount is correct as an initial commitment, but there's no monthly cap field or cadence (we bill monthly). We need a clear monthly cap or a note that this is "pilot - monthly cap $25,000" so we can set up monthly invoicing limits.

We can accept the PO as-is if Redwood is comfortable issuing a corrected PO that splits line items and adds the monthly cap note. Otherwise we will need to manually map which invoices draw down the single lump PO which can cause reconciliation lag.

Thanks Michael — and thanks Alyssa for moving quickly.

We will re-issue a corrected PO within the hour with the requested line-item breakdown and an explicit monthly pilot cap of $25,000. Process notes for the record: 

- Action: Procurement (me) to generate PO-34219-REV1, splitting the total into:
  * Inference Units - realtime (monthly estimate)
  * Support - standard
  * Instance / infra surcharge (if applicable)
- The revised PO will include a note: "Pilot monthly cap $25,000; automated alert at 80%."
- Karthik — please apply the spend guard to the BlueHarbor account on receipt of PO-34219-REV1 and set "block at 100%" with email escalation to procurement and partnerships.
- Hannah — we'll tag the ledger as "Pilot / provisional-PO" so finance can reconcile once SOW finalizes.

I'll attach the revision and loop back when it's posted to AP. If either of you prefer a different line label, speak now so we can avoid another revision.
